summary.name: Murf AI
summary.one_liner: Murf AI is an AI voice platform offering text-to-speech APIs, studio voiceover generation, AI video dubbing, and multilingual conversational voice agents.
use_cases: Generating AI voiceovers for explainer and e-learning videos
Building real-time voice agents for customer support and sales calls
Dubbing videos into multiple languages while keeping the original voice
Adding text-to-speech audio to apps via API
Creating audiobook, podcast, or YouTube narration
summary.what_it_does: Murf offers a text-to-speech API (Falcon 2, which the page says returns first audio in under 100ms) for real-time applications, and Gen2 for controllable voiceover generation with tone, pacing and emphasis controls. Murf Studio provides 200+ expressive voices across 35+ languages, a custom pronunciation library, pitch/speed/intonation control, and integrations with Canva, PowerPoint and Captivate. AI Dubbing localizes videos into 40+ languages while preserving the original voice and tone. Murf Agents are multilingual conversational agents for inbound and outbound calls and chat that can escalate to humans. The page also claims a 'Say it My Way' feature that lets users record their own voice to guide the generated speech.
notable: Falcon 2 TTS model claims sub-100ms time-to-first-audio, benchmarked by the page against ElevenLabs, Cartesia, Deepgram and Sarvam
Supports 35+ languages with AI dubbing into 40+ languages
Startup incubator offers 50 million free API characters for 3 months
Page states commercial rights for voiceovers on paid plans
caveats: Free plan has a 10-minute voice generation limit and no commercial license
Voice downloads require a paid plan
Unlimited voice generation is usually only available on paid plans
Performance claims (latency ranking, 99.38% pronunciation accuracy) are the vendor's own reported tests
